events.description: Clips, transcripts and images checksummed and addressable — story work can begin
Scenes hang on the spine in story order
Rough cut complete with temp sound — ready to screen
Director/producers request editorial changes — back to the bench
Picture lock — no further editorial changes
Color grade approved shot by shot
Dialogue, music and effects mixed to final levels
Delivery master passes technical quality control
QC found a picture defect — regrade required
QC found an audio defect — remix required
The screening room is not enough — the work needs to be carried onto the land
What presence on the land taught returns as feedback into the cut
Someone presses play — the master finds an audience
The listener moves on — the media advances, the story holds
A listener leaves the master line to author their own narrative

states.name: Composition
states.description: Where the recording lands — voice clips, transcripts, images and takes gathered and made addressable

transitions.description: Material safe and addressable — story work begins

states.name: StorySpine
states.description: The thematic spine every rib attaches to and every fork branches from — scenes laid in story order

transitions.description: Spine holds — refine into a full cut

states.name: RoughCut
states.description: Full-length cut with temp sound and placeholder VFX

transitions.description: Cut screens for director and producers

states.name: Review
states.description: Director and producers screen the cut — verdict branches here

transitions.description: LOOP — notes go back to the spine
The verdict is neither approve nor revise — the work goes to the land first

states.name: ColorGrade
states.description: Picture-locked footage graded shot by shot

transitions.description: Graded picture hands off to the mix stage

states.name: SoundMix
states.description: Dialogue, music and effects mixed against the graded picture

transitions.description: Final mix conforms into the delivery master

states.name: Master
states.description: Grade and mix conformed into the delivery master — QC gate

transitions.description: BRANCH — picture defect routes back to the grade
BRANCH — audio defect routes back to the mix

states.name: Released
states.description: Master delivered — no longer an ending, but the door an audience walks in through

transitions.description: ENTRY — someone presses play and the traversal begins

states.name: Playback
states.description: The audience is inside the media — listening, moving through it in time

transitions.description: INTERNAL — the media advances, the story holds its shape
FORK — the listener becomes an author and comes home to the spine

states.name: OnTheLand
states.description: The circle goes on the land — knowledge received through presence, place, and relations, not through the screen

transitions.description: LOOP — land-given knowledge feeds back into the spine as lived feedback
